items.title: Caves of Qud: Diaspora breaks new ground by being the first early access DLC release on Steam
items.en_title: Caves of Qud: Diaspora breaks new ground by being the first early access DLC release on Steam
items.en_oneliner: Caves of Qud's Diaspora DLC will become Steam's first early access DLC, with the base game fully released while the DLC continues the early access route.

items.title: Dev snapshot: Godot 4.8 beta 1
items.en_oneliner: Godot 4.8 beta 1 is out, with the version entering feature freeze, and the team calling on developers to join the bug-hunting sprint to find regressions.
